# netactuate_vpc_floating_ips (Data Source)

Reads VPC Floating Ips visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_vpc_floating_ips" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID whose floating IPs will be listed

### Read-Only

- `floating_ips` (List of Object) List of floating IPs attached to the VPC (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ips))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--floating_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `floating_ips`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `floating_ip_id` (Number)
- `ip_version` (Number)
- `is_primary` (Boolean)
- `ptr` (String)
